title.zh-Hans: DIOR 大颖 2026 伦敦站扩展预测

description.zh-Hans: 基于伦敦官方场地／主办宣传、台北站观测顺序、巡演报道和用户提供的社区歌单交叉整理。包含 17 首高置信度核心、24 首伦敦综合预测、24 首台北参考顺序和 20 首轮换候选；所有预测均明确标注置信度，不代表官方最终歌单。
description.en: Cross-checked from official London venue/promoter material, the observed Taipei sequence, tour reporting, and user-supplied community playlists. Includes a 17-song high-confidence core, a 24-song London composite prediction, the 24-track Taipei reference order, and a 20-song rotation pool. Confidence labels are explicit; none is presented as the final official London running order.

title.zh-Hans: 台北站 2026-04-17 观测参考顺序

notes.zh-Hans: 顺序来自用户提供的 KKBOX 24 首歌单，并以 MTV 台北演出回顾核对开场、核心曲目、Day 2 轮换和结尾。它不是官方舞台 cue sheet。
notes.en: The order follows a user-supplied 24-track KKBOX playlist and is cross-checked against MTV’s post-show report for the opener, tour anchors, Day 2 substitutions and finale. It is not an official stage cue sheet.

title.zh-Hans: 伦敦站高置信度核心（17 首）

notes.zh-Hans: 17 首核心候选：伦敦官方宣传点名曲目，加上多站稳定出现的巡演主轴。它是高置信度准备清单，不是官方顺序。
notes.en: A 17-song preparation core combining titles named by official London promotion with recurring tour anchors. High confidence, but not an official running order.

title.zh-Hans: 伦敦站完整综合预测（24 首）

notes.zh-Hans: 24 首综合预测；低置信度翻唱位和 Kampung Girl reprise 均标为 optional。预计实际伦敦场会从轮换池替换若干位置。
notes.en: A 24-song composite prediction. Low-confidence cover slots and the Kampung Girl reprise are marked optional; the actual London show may substitute items from the rotation pool.

title.zh-Hans: 轮换／翻唱／地区限定候选池（20 首）
title.en: Rotation / Cover / Regional Candidate Pool (20 songs)

notes.zh-Hans: 这些歌曲来自台北两日差异、歌迷预习歌单和地区轮换证据；不应整体加入主预测，也不代表伦敦将演唱。
notes.en: These songs come from Taipei day-to-day variation, fan preparation playlists and regional rotation evidence. The pool should not be treated as a single predicted set or as confirmation for London.

sources.title: DIOR 大颖 2026 KAMPUNG GIRL World Tour in London
sources.notes: Official London promoter listing. Confirms 2 September 2026, Clapham Grand and a 19:30 show start; the listed 21:30 VIP photo-session time suggests, but does not guarantee, an approximately two-hour performance window. No running order is published.

sources.title: DIOR 大颖 2026 KAMPUNG GIRL World Tour in London
sources.notes: Official venue listing naming representative songs: Love Myself More, I’ve Been Better, If That Phone Call Had Been Answered, See You, Go Slow to Go Fast, YOLO, This Lifetime of Ours, Save Some and Mutual Friends. It is promotional repertoire, not a final setlist.

sources.title: DIOR 大颖台北站演出回顾与两日轮换信息
sources.notes: Post-show report confirming the Taipei tour spine and named Day 1/Day 2 substitutions. It confirms major anchors but not every position in the full running order.
